ink-black.$description: Ink Black — All text — display headlines, body copy, navigation links, and icon strokes

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary and supporting text — link hover or muted labels where visual weight must recede

lab-grotesque.$description: Sole typeface for the entire site. Weight 100 at 40px is the signature display treatment for the owner name and year — a near-ultralight stroke that reads as quietly confident against the white void. Weight 400 at 18px handles body and link text. Weight 600 at 20px gives nav links a subtle mechanical weight without crossing into bold territory. No other families appear.
